_readme: Owner-accepted criteria notes distilled from weekly reviews (newsletter/triage/lessons.py). Appended to the scoring prompt brief. Edit by accepting/rejecting in the control panel.

lessons.text: Avoid content targeting exclusively executive or C-suite career paths; career-and-identity picks should apply to managers and individual contributors broadly.
Named-executive Q&A on company strategy scores lower than practitioner essays unless the speaker appears on the approved innovation-voices list.
Research or essay pieces examining what AI cannot replace in human work or creativity are high-value innovation picks alongside pieces on what AI changes.
